QUOTE: The assembly is selected by `constant_time_impl.h:40–52`. It needs `MBEDTLS_HAVE_ASM`, a GNU-compatible compiler (not MSVC, not ARMCC 5), and one of the four supported architectures.
VERDICT: MISS
WHY: The answer never names MBEDTLS_CT_ASM or says it is derived rather than set in mbedtls_config.h; it only describes the selection conditions.
